user.title: Connect to IM CAM
user.description: Enter your IM CAM account login. Client registration is included with this integration.

init.title: Server transcoding
init.description: Install the IM CAM Transcoder app, set a random API key of at least 32 characters in its options, then enter the same key here. The additional camera converts video to H.264 on the Home Assistant host.

error.invalid_transcoder_url: Enter the app's internal HTTP or HTTPS URL.
error.api_key_too_short: Enter the same API key configured in the app (at least 32 characters).
